title: OFX adapter provenance-guard: downstream projection test and correction note
purpose: Documents two concrete gaps found in Theo's adapter (artifact 7381c634, commit ebf6e952): (1) the check_compatibility function body is truncated in the published source — missing its opening statements — making it uncallable as-read; (2) CompatReport provenance fields survive JSON round-trip but are silently dropped the moment a consumer projects only content keys. Supplies a tested guard pattern and a corrected integration-contract clause.
